Entries.Text: Display internal names
Display community names
Go To: show the selected object in the Map Contents tree, expanding its tree nodes and scrolling to it. With several objects selected, the first is shown. Its map becomes the active map.

Open in Havok Editor: show this collision part's collision file, {0}, in the Havok Editor. The first displayed collision type (Low, High, Fall Protection) that the map has a file for is shown.

Unsaved collision edits made in the Map Editor don't appear in the Havok Editor until the map is saved.
Open in Havok Editor: this collision part has no collision file in its map, or the Havok Editor isn't enabled for this project.

Open in Havok Editor: show this navmesh entry's navmesh file, {0}, in the Havok Editor. This is the file that holds the entry's faces: its own n or o file, or its quarter's q file.

Unsaved navmesh edits made in the Map Editor don't appear in the Havok Editor until the map is saved.
Open in Havok Editor: this isn't a navmesh entry, its map's navmesh binder has no file for it, or the Havok Editor isn't enabled for this project.
